metadata.label: Abstract
metadata.value: When I Wé Cudaiq becomes pregnant Sawérigading no Ionger visits her. I Wé Cudaiq gives birth to I La Galigo and I Wé Cimpau to a daughter named Wé Makawaru Daéng Paraga. I La Galigo is removed from the palace and sent to Mario, because his mother does not want to live with him under one roof. Sawérigading takes I La Galigo back to Cina. His marriage with I Wé Cudaiq is revealed and they all stay together in the palace La Tanété. An attempt of I Wé Cudaiq to kill I Wé Cimpau fails.
